newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BA strike to affect Cape Town-London flights.
newsitem.headline: BA strike to affect Cape Town-London flights.

text.p: British Airways direct flights between Cape Town and London would not operate on Friday and Saturday due to a 72-hour strike by the airline's cabin crew which started on Wednesday, British Airways said.
Commercial manager for Africa, John Brayford, said in a statement passengers had been re-routed via Johannesburg or booked on other carriers.
But the airline said it would continue to operate all its Johannesburg services.

"We have made contingencies to ensure that all our other South African-London services continue to operate and are contacting all passengers travelling beyond London, who may be booked on affected flights," Brayford said.
Where possible, passengers would be re-booked on other British Airways services or transferred to other carriers, he added.
